description: crates/mail/src/mta_sts_cache.rs implements MtaStsCache backed by mta_sts_cache table. Migration 0015 drops that table with comment 'cache was never implemented'. The module is re-exported from lib.rs (pub use mta_sts_cache::...) but has no callers outside its own tests. If any future code instantiates MtaStsCache::get() or store() it will hit a 'no such table' runtime error. The module is dead code that misrepresents the implementation — it suggests persistence is wired when it is not. Remove the module, its re-export, and migration 0014 (which is made inert by 0015 dropping the table immediately after).
title: Remove dead MtaStsCache module (table dropped by migration 0015)
